$schema.title: JSON Schema URI
$schema.description: Versioned URL of the JSON Schema used to validate this record; it must identify the same artifact as schema.ipfs_uri and schema.hash

hash.title: Schema Hash
hash.description: SHA-256 digest of the canonical JSON Schema object identified by this version and IPFS URI

type.title: Credit Schema Type
type.description: Discriminator value identifying this record as a Credit environmental-impact token

version.title: Schema Version
version.description: Version of the schema, using semantic versioning

ipfs_uri.title: Schema IPFS URI
ipfs_uri.description: IPFS URI of the exact pinned JSON Schema artifact whose version and hash are recorded alongside it

created_at.title: Created At
created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this metadata document was created; it is not the date of the underlying event or methodology publication

external_id.title: External ID
external_id.description: UUID v4 identifier linking this IPFS record to its counterpart in the Carrot platform and other consuming systems

ipfs_uri.title: Viewer IPFS URI
ipfs_uri.description: IPFS URI of the metadata viewer dApp build

viewer_reference.title: Metadata Viewer Reference
viewer_reference.description: Immutable reference to the metadata viewer dApp build. The IPFS CID itself is the integrity proof: tampered content resolves to a different CID

blockchain_network.title: Blockchain Network
blockchain_network.description: Blockchain network where this record is deployed

deployment.title: Deployment Environment
deployment.description: System environment where this record was generated

data_set_name.title: Data Set Name
data_set_name.description: Name of the data set for this record

slug.title: Credit Token Slug
slug.description: URL-friendly identifier for the credit token

name.title: On-chain Credit Token Name
name.description: Exact ERC-20 name() value for the deployed credit contract; it may differ from a product display label

chain_id.title: Positive Integer
chain_id.description: Integer value that is greater than zero

smart_contract_address.title: Smart Contract Address
smart_contract_address.description: Ethereum-compatible address of the smart contract that mints and manages this token

blockchain.title: Credit Contract Identity
blockchain.description: Network and ERC-20 contract whose tokenURI() resolves this document. ERC-20 has no token_id.

erc1046.title: ERC-1046 Interoperability
erc1046.description: Declares this metadata document compatible with ERC-1046.

interop.title: Interoperability
interop.description: Mandatory ERC-1046 marker for both PROD and TEST credit documents.

decimals.title: Token Decimals
decimals.description: Number of decimal places for the ERC20 token

image.title: Token Image
image.description: IPFS URI pointing to the token's visual representation image

description.title: Token Description
description.description: Human-readable purpose and impact pathway of this ERC-20 credit token; quantitative claims require their own evidence
examples: Illustrative carbon credit metadata for a fictional ERC-20 contract. Its name, symbol, decimals, and network must match the deployed contract before any real document is generated.

title: Credit IPFS Record
description: Credit token metadata stored in IPFS, extending the base schema with ERC20-specific details
